newsitem.title: USA: Neurobiological Tech says group starts test.
newsitem.headline: Neurobiological Tech says group starts test.

text.p: Neurobiological Technologies Inc said on Wednesday a research group has started a Phase II clinical trial of the company's neuroprotectant drug called Memantine.

The group, called the Adult Aids Clinical Trials Group (AACTG), is a clinical research network supported by the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) of the National Institutes of Health.
The trial will evaluate Memantine's ability to reduce dementia and neuropathic pain in AIDS patients for which there are currently no effective treatments, the company said.
Neurobiological Technologies will supply Memantine and will have the right to use the data from the trial for the further commercial development of Memantine, it said.
